items.title: Helen Oakley Dance interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998

ctx.x: Bud [Freeman], there was — well I didn’t know Teschemacher — but I mean it was a wonderful school.

Yeah. It was a wonderful school. I mean I still get things like that and Stanley’s face doesn’t light up like mine does, but that was my background, all white jazz. And I consider it was — I don’t know where there were backgrounds for white jazz. The people that liked Bix, they were, and Squirrel Ashcraft was a very close friend of Bix’s. And you know the bass saxophone, Rollini, and people. That was the white thing coming up. And it really was very important. Because those were white guys who were moved. And…
